title: Stoner Cursors
description: Sleek, high-contrast cursors for a clean UI experience
body:
Stoner Cursors is a professional-grade cursor collection designed to bring a sleek, modern, and high-contrast look to your Minecraft interface. This pack completely transforms your in-game pointer into a clean, bold aesthetic that ensures maximum visibility on any background.

Designed with compatibility as a top priority, Stoner Cursors features full support for both Minecraft Cursors and Cursors Extended frameworks. Whether you are navigating complex menus or managing your inventory, our custom-coded animations and color-coded states (Busy, Link, Grabbing, and more) provide a premium feel to your gameplay.

Old Banner (1.0)
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/424b686a5bc895754d629d4e894c55aff114969a.png)

New Banner (2.0)
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6d6936c1afc36e5895e33b39b555dfa544a72c1.png)
Key Features:

    🖱️ Full Animation: Smooth transitions for loading and busy states.

    🌈 Color Feedback: Unique designs for links, help, and forbidden actions.

    ⚡ High Contrast: Bold outlines for better tracking during fast-paced play.

    🛠️ Universal Support: Works seamlessly with all major cursor mods.

For the best visual experience, pair this with the [Stoner Dark](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stoner-dark) pack!

**This resource pack requires Cursors Extended or Minecraft Cursor Mod (same link).**
